name: Sweep-based SDF Generation
aliases: Sweep-based SDF Generation — Approximate Distance Field computation, Marching Parabolas, Sweep-based SDF generation
definition: A method to compute an approximate Signed Distance Field (SDF) by sweeping a 2D or 3D texture along axes using shared memory and a parabolic distance approximation, intended for use in Sphere Tracing.
summary: Sweep-based SDF Generation is an efficient algorithm that computes approximate Signed Distance Fields for sphere tracing by propagating distance information through multi-pass sweeps, trading geometric precision for speed.
